subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the shear wall between Sheet S-301 and Foundation

messages.text: The shear wall reinforcement shown in Sheet S-301 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Foundation Plan S-101. This is urgent -- we need direction as soon as possible. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible. This sits right on the edge, timeline-wise; hard to say for certain how quickly this really needs to move.
Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Foundation Plan S-101; Sheet S-301 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification.
